title: Repository Integrity Stabilization
objective: Stabilize repository integrity across nunncorp-global-mono, SentinelOS NON-DEMO, deployment lineage, and build continuity without destructive cleanup.
tasks: Snapshot current repo state before modification.
Identify stale lock files, duplicated git internals, hanging operations, and workspace integrity anomalies.
Perform controlled lock cleanup only after explicit approval and backup/fresh-clone confirmation.
Validate git status, branch integrity, commit lineage, and worktree continuity.
Produce Repo Integrity Report, Drift Classification, and recommended remediation boundaries.
rules: Do not delete lock files without explicit operator approval.
